fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-11-20, around 18:10, the complainant received an SMS with a link resembling a bank notification; after entering card details on the page, Rs. 24,000 was debited, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-11-20. The account reference SYN-ACC-100057 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A person named Dinesh Subramani, associated with the number 9000000212, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, bank account, mobile number, screenshot, suspect, residential colony, digital document
